name: Amphimon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may trash up to 4 blue cards in your hand. For each one, trash any 1 card under your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, return 1 of their Digimon or Tamers without cards under it to the hand.
[When Attacking] By returning 3 cards with [Jellymon] in their texts from your trash to the bottom of the deck, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
set_name: LM-01: Limited Card Pack Digimon Ghost Game
